title: Fascinating Chinese Place Names
synopsis: Can you guess these Chinese place name riddles?

fullText.simplified:
有趣的中国地名

    你了解中国吗？你熟悉中国地图吗？要想看明白下边的文章，快去先看一遍中国地图吧！这样文章看起来才会更有趣！
    中国自古以来就有“猜谜”的传统，比如元宵节的猜灯谜，生活中的猜字谜等等。中国人喜欢猜谜，愿意猜谜。这不他们又用猜谜的形式为很多地名设计了有趣的谜语！
    为了方便大家查找地图，我们直接挑选了两个地区。
    先来说说山西，你知道“圆规画鸡蛋”说的是哪里吗？“看着都差不多”是哪个城市？
    再来说说安徽，“两个胖子开会”是安徽哪个地区？“前后左右没有湖”又是哪里呢？
    怎么样？你猜出来了吗？有没有在地图上找到它们呢？
     “圆规”是用来画“圆”的工具。用圆规画出来的鸡蛋肯定特别圆，“太原”的谐音是“太圆”。所以“圆规画鸡蛋”的谜底就是山西太原；“看着都差不多”指的是山西大同。“同”的意思是一样，“大”有一个意思是大概，差不多。所以“大同”字面意思就是“差不多一样”，那不就是看着都差不多吗？
    “两个胖子开会”是安徽合肥。“肥”是胖的意思，“合”有“全、都”的意思。“开会的都是胖子”不就是“合肥”吗？“芜”谐音“无”，意思是没有。“前后左右没有湖”的谜语是安徽“芜湖”。
    看完大家也不要误会，这些谜语用的都是谐音或者歪解意思的方法，就是图个开心，不是地名真正的含义。类似的地名谜语还有很多，以后慢慢告诉大家。
fullText.traditional:
有趣的中國地名

    你瞭解中國嗎？你熟悉中國地圖嗎？要想看明白下邊的文章，快去先看一遍中國地圖吧！這樣文章看起來才會更有趣！
    中國自古以來就有“猜謎”的傳統，比如元宵節的猜燈謎，生活中的猜字謎等等。中國人喜歡猜謎，願意猜謎。這不他們又用猜謎的形式為很多地名設計了有趣的謎語！
    為了方便大家查找地圖，我們直接挑選了兩個地區。
    先來說說山西，你知道“圓規畫雞蛋”說的是哪裏嗎？“看著都差不多”是哪個城市？
    再來說說安徽，“兩個胖子開會”是安徽哪個地區？“前後左右沒有湖”又是哪裏呢？
    怎麼樣？你猜出來了嗎？有沒有在地圖上找到它們呢？
     “圓規”是用來畫“圓”的工具。用圓規畫出來的雞蛋肯定特別圓，“太原”的諧音是“太圓”。所以“圓規畫雞蛋”的謎底就是山西太原；“看著都差不多”指的是山西大同。“同”的意思是一樣，“大”有一個意思是大概，差不多。所以“大同”字面意思就是“差不多一樣”，那不就是看著都差不多嗎？
    “兩個胖子開會”是安徽合肥。“肥”是胖的意思，“合”有“全、都”的意思。“開會的都是胖子”不就是“合肥”嗎？“蕪”諧音“無”，意思是沒有。“前後左右沒有湖”的謎語是安徽“蕪湖”。
    看完大家也不要誤會，這些謎語用的都是諧音或者歪解意思的方法，就是圖個開心，不是地名真正的含義。類似的地名謎語還有很多，以後慢慢告訴大家。

sentences.simplified: 你了解中国吗？你熟悉中国地图吗？
sentences.traditional: 你瞭解中國嗎？你熟悉中國地圖嗎？

sentences.simplified: 要想看明白下边的文章，快去先看一遍中国地图吧！
sentences.traditional: 要想看明白下邊的文章，快去先看一遍中國地圖吧！
sentences.pinyin: yào xiǎng kàn míng bai xià bian de wén zhāng kuài qù xiān kàn yí biàn zhōng guó dì tú ba
sentences.english: Are you knowledgeable about China? Are you familiar with the map of China?

sentences.simplified: 这样文章看起来才会更有趣！
sentences.traditional: 這樣文章看起來才會更有趣！
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng wén zhāng kàn qi lai cái huì gèng yǒu qù
sentences.english: If you want to understand this article, go take a look at a map of China first!
This way, the article will be more interesting to read!

sentences.traditional: 比如元宵節的猜燈謎，生活中的猜字謎等等。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú yuán xiāo jié de cāi dēng mí shēng huó zhōng de cāi zì mí děng děng

sentences.simplified: 中国人喜欢猜谜，愿意猜谜。
sentences.traditional: 中國人喜歡猜謎，願意猜謎。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén xǐ huan cāi mí yuàn yì cāi mí
sentences.english: For example, solving lantern riddles during the Lantern Festival or solving word riddles in everyday life.

sentences.simplified: 这不他们又用猜谜的形式为很多地名设计了有趣的谜语！
sentences.traditional: 這不他們又用猜謎的形式為很多地名設計了有趣的謎語！
sentences.pinyin: zhè bu tā men yòu yòng cāi mí de xíng shì wèi hěn duō dì míng shè jì le yǒu qù de mí yǔ
sentences.english: Chinese people like solving riddles, and they are willing to solve riddles.
As a matter of fact, they have also used the format of solving riddles to design fascinating place name riddles!

sentences.simplified: 为了方便大家查找地图，我们直接挑选了两个地区。
sentences.traditional: 為了方便大家查找地圖，我們直接挑選了兩個地區。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le fāng biàn dà jiā chá zhǎo dì tú wǒ men zhí jiē tiāo xuǎn le liǎng ge dì qū

sentences.english: To make looking these up on a map easier, we went ahead and picked two regions.

sentences.simplified: 先来说说山西，你知道“圆规画鸡蛋”说的是哪里吗？
sentences.traditional: 先來說說山西，你知道“圓規畫雞蛋”說的是哪裏嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiān lái shuō shuo shān xī nǐ zhī dào yuán guī huà jī dàn shuō de shì nǎ lǐ ma

sentences.simplified: “看着都差不多”是哪个城市？
sentences.traditional: “看著都差不多”是哪個城市？
sentences.pinyin: kàn zhe dōu chà bu duō shì nǎ ge chéng shì
sentences.english: First, let’s talk about Shanxi. Do you know where “drawing an egg with a compass” refers to?
What city is “looks about the same”?

sentences.simplified: 再来说说安徽，“两个胖子开会”是安徽哪个地区？
sentences.traditional: 再來說說安徽，“兩個胖子開會”是安徽哪個地區？
sentences.pinyin: zài lái shuō shuo ān huī liǎng ge pàng zi kāi huì shì ān huī nǎ ge dì qū

sentences.simplified: “前后左右没有湖”又是哪里呢？
sentences.traditional: “前後左右沒有湖”又是哪裏呢？
sentences.pinyin: qián hòu zuǒ yòu méi yǒu hú yòu shì nǎ lǐ ne
sentences.english: Next, let’s talk about Anhui. Which region of Anhui does “two fat people having a meeting” refer to?
And where does “no lakes all around” refer to?

sentences.simplified: 怎么样？你猜出来了吗？有没有在地图上找到它们呢？
sentences.traditional: 怎麼樣？你猜出來了嗎？有沒有在地圖上找到它們呢？
sentences.pinyin: zěn me yàng nǐ cāi chu lai le ma yǒu méi yǒu zài dì tú shang zhǎo dào tā men ne

sentences.english: So? Have you guessed? Have you found them on the map?

sentences.simplified: “圆规”是用来画“圆”的工具。
sentences.traditional: “圓規”是用來畫“圓”的工具。
sentences.pinyin: yuán guī shì yòng lái huà yuán de gōng jù

sentences.simplified: 用圆规画出来的鸡蛋肯定特别圆，“太原”的谐音是“太圆”。
sentences.traditional: 用圓規畫出來的雞蛋肯定特別圓，“太原”的諧音是“太圓”。
sentences.pinyin: yòng yuán guī huà chu lai de jī dàn kěn dìng tè bié yuán tài yuán de xié yīn shì tài yuán
sentences.english: A compass is a tool used for drawing circles.

sentences.simplified: 所以“圆规画鸡蛋”的谜底就是山西太原；
sentences.traditional: 所以“圓規畫雞蛋”的謎底就是山西太原；
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ yuán guī huà jī dàn de mí dǐ jiù shì shān xī tài yuán
sentences.english: An egg drawn using a compass will certainly be particularly round, and “Taiyuan” is a homophone of “too round”.

sentences.simplified: “看着都差不多”指的是山西大同。
sentences.traditional: “看著都差不多”指的是山西大同。
sentences.pinyin: kàn zhe dōu chà bu duō zhǐ de shì shān xī dà tóng
sentences.english: So, the answer to the riddle “drawing an egg with a compass” is Taiyuan in Shanxi province.

sentences.simplified: “同”的意思是一样，“大”有一个意思是大概，差不多。
sentences.traditional: “同”的意思是一樣，“大”有一個意思是大概，差不多。
sentences.pinyin: tóng de yì si shì yí yàng dà yǒu yí ge yì si shì dà gài chà bu duō
sentences.english: “Looks about the same” refers to Datong in Shanxi province.

sentences.simplified: 所以“大同”字面意思就是“差不多一样”，那不就是看着都差不多吗？
sentences.traditional: 所以“大同”字面意思就是“差不多一樣”，那不就是看著都差不多嗎？
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ dà tóng zì miàn yì si jiù shì chà bu duō yí yàng nà bú jiù shì kàn zhe dōu chà bu duō ma
sentences.english: “Tong” means the same. One meaning of “da” is approximately or about.
So, “Datong” literally means “about the same”. Then isn’t that “looks about the same”?

sentences.simplified: “两个胖子开会”是安徽合肥。
sentences.traditional: “兩個胖子開會”是安徽合肥。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge pàng zi kāi huì shì ān huī hé féi

sentences.simplified: “肥”是胖的意思，“合”有“全、都”的意思。“开会的都是胖子”不就是“合肥”吗？
sentences.traditional: “肥”是胖的意思，“合”有“全、都”的意思。“開會的都是胖子”不就是“合肥”嗎？
sentences.pinyin: féi shì pàng de yì si hé yǒu quán dōu de yì si kāi huì de dōu shì pàng zi bú jiù shì hé féi ma
sentences.english: “Two fat people having a meeting” is Hefei in Anhui province.

sentences.simplified: “芜”谐音“无”，意思是没有。
sentences.traditional: “蕪”諧音“無”，意思是沒有。
sentences.pinyin: wú xié yīn wú yì si shì méi yǒu
sentences.english: “Fei” means fat, and “he” means “all” or “both”. Is “two fat people having a meeting” not “Hefei”?

sentences.simplified: “前后左右没有湖”的谜语是安徽“芜湖”。
sentences.traditional: “前後左右沒有湖”的謎語是安徽“蕪湖”。
sentences.pinyin: qián hòu zuǒ yòu méi yǒu hú de mí yǔ shì ān huī wú hú
sentences.english: “Wu” is a homophone of “wu”, meaning to not have.
The answer to the riddle “no lakes all around” is Wuhu, in Anhui province.

sentences.simplified: 看完大家也不要误会，这些谜语用的都是谐音或者歪解意思的方法，
sentences.traditional: 看完大家也不要誤會，這些謎語用的都是諧音或者歪解意思的方法，
sentences.pinyin: kàn wán dà jiā yě bú yào wù huì zhè xiē mí yǔ yòng de dōu shì xié yīn huò zhě wāi jiě yì si de fāng fǎ

sentences.simplified: 就是图个开心，不是地名真正的含义。
sentences.traditional: 就是圖個開心，不是地名真正的含義。
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì tú ge kāi xīn bú shì dì míng zhēn zhèng de hán yì
sentences.english: Do not misinterpret what you have just read. These riddles are all created using homophones or distorting the meaning.

sentences.simplified: 类似的地名谜语还有很多，以后慢慢告诉大家。
sentences.traditional: 類似的地名謎語還有很多，以後慢慢告訴大家。
sentences.pinyin: lèi sì de dì míng mí yǔ hái yǒu hěn duō yǐ hòu màn man gào su dà jiā
sentences.english: They are just for fun and are not the true meaning behind the place names.
There are many more place name riddles similar to these. I will tell everyone about them next time.

raw.synopsis: Can you guess these Chinese place name riddles?
sentence_translations: Fascinating Chinese Place Names
Are you knowledgeable about China? Are you familiar with the map of China?
If you want to understand this article, go take a look at a map of China first!
This way, the article will be more interesting to read!
China has had the tradition of “solving riddles” since ancient times.
For example, solving lantern riddles during the Lantern Festival or solving word riddles in everyday life.
Chinese people like solving riddles, and they are willing to solve riddles.
As a matter of fact, they have also used the format of solving riddles to design fascinating place name riddles!
To make looking these up on a map easier, we went ahead and picked two regions.
First, let’s talk about Shanxi. Do you know where “drawing an egg with a compass” refers to?
What city is “looks about the same”?
Next, let’s talk about Anhui. Which region of Anhui does “two fat people having a meeting” refer to?
And where does “no lakes all around” refer to?
So? Have you guessed? Have you found them on the map?
A compass is a tool used for drawing circles.
An egg drawn using a compass will certainly be particularly round, and “Taiyuan” is a homophone of “too round”.
So, the answer to the riddle “drawing an egg with a compass” is Taiyuan in Shanxi province.
“Looks about the same” refers to Datong in Shanxi province.
“Tong” means the same. One meaning of “da” is approximately or about.
So, “Datong” literally means “about the same”. Then isn’t that “looks about the same”?
“Two fat people having a meeting” is Hefei in Anhui province.
“Fei” means fat, and “he” means “all” or “both”. Is “two fat people having a meeting” not “Hefei”?
“Wu” is a homophone of “wu”, meaning to not have.
The answer to the riddle “no lakes all around” is Wuhu, in Anhui province.
Do not misinterpret what you have just read. These riddles are all created using homophones or distorting the meaning.
They are just for fun and are not the true meaning behind the place names.
There are many more place name riddles similar to these. I will tell everyone about them next time.
